risk_note: CT-24zzv (BR-ID-34, planning couli#26; D10-2783 / 2792 / 2821 / 2826 / 2838 / 2900 / 2943 / 2963 / 2970): contract only — /admin/v1 operations marked x-step-up (sudo 15, strict 9), the 48 operations BR-ID-34 lists as none lose AdminStepUpToken, 10003 and the step-up wording (resolveAdminPayOrder stays none, owner 2026-11-25, approvals 185); AdminStepUpTier keeps totp / sms and adds sudo / strict (the old values are removed by a later contract task); AdminStepUpMethod and the request field method (legacy name tier accepted); 10003 data is tier or reason; descriptions state that a strict token is bound to the first strict operation that takes it and is not named at issue (D10-2900 ①, owner confirmed), 5 minutes, spent on business success / retried after a definite failure / held when the outcome is unknown, code=0 with outcome=rejected does not spend it (D10-2943, owner confirmed), me/permissions tier is the highest tier and display only. Rounds: rule tests 3 + exception rounds under approvals 177, 179, 190 + one deletion-only fix (D10-2927); implementation 3 + the reserve round of approvals 179 (D10-2943); one mechanical tidy commit (D10-2963). Follow-ups: FU-CT24ZZV-SPECTEST-R2, FU-CT24ZZV-STEPUP-DATA-TIER-ALLOF, the contract task removing totp / sms, B1-18l.
